answer: Each epoch an admission auction sells 100 velvet passes, one per identity, for dune plots. The anchor price opens at 45 credits, climbs 5 per sale to 540 by the hundredth pass, and binds each pass to one dune plot and one key. A farm buying 1,000 passes needs 10 epochs, paying 292,500 against a 40,000 pool. Auditors void a rented velvet pass whose key mismatches its bidder and burn the bid; an honest agent pays 45 once at the opening anchor.
